representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database with worker and non-worker personas

rowCountQueries: Count confirmed/active assignments with check_in_out permission
Record grants and RLS state for both dependency tables
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: No existing rows are updated; two empty append-only tables, four indexes, and four policies are added

execution.resumeStrategy: The migration is additive and rerunnable; guarded tables, indexes, and policies converge objects
execution.idempotency: Tables and indexes use IF NOT EXISTS; policies are created only when absent

quarantine.strategy: No tenant or legacy row is inferred, mapped, or backfilled

constraints: one acknowledgement per assignment and publication
one result per user client request id
context must be a JSON object
foreign keys preserve assignment and publication evidence
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify own-assignment select/insert succeeds, cross-user and unpermitted inserts fail, and duplicate client request ids converge

recovery.rollback: Disable FEATURE_WORK_MODE_WORKER_ACTIONS; preserve append-only evidence and leave additive tables in place
recovery.forwardFix: Apply a reviewed additive policy, constraint, or indexing migration

queries: Verify RLS and FORCE RLS on both new tables
Verify authenticated has SELECT and INSERT only and anon has no grants
Verify worker insert succeeds and cross-user insert fails
